title: Coinbase Customer Data Hit in Analytics Vendor Breach, Funds ‘Not Impacted’
summary: The incident at analytics firm Amplitude hit a "small subset" of Coinbase customers, the exchange said, without saying how many.

title: Bithumb Says Hackers Accessed Internal System, Leaking Personal Data
summary: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange is checking whether customer data was exposed, as two other financial firms report breaches.

summary: Vlad Tenev delivered the messaging that Robinhood Chain enthusiasts wanted to hear—and the market responded.

title: Moody's Rates Ripple's $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin A2, a Day After OCC Bank Approval
summary: The ratings agency cited RLUSD's Treasury-heavy reserves, but noted that holders have no direct ownership interest in them for now.

title: Goldman, BlackRock Alumni Raise $4 Million to Put Farm and Apartment Loans Onchain
summary: Birch Hill, founded by Goldman Sachs and BlackRock alumni, raised $4 million in a seed round led by Multicoin Capital to build a regulated path for bringing U.S. loans onchain.

title: House Oversight Chair Comer Probes Delaware Plan for AI-Run Companies
summary: James Comer warned the proposed "AIC" could shield AI firms from liability, and asked Delaware's governor for documents by November 9.

title: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola Among 7 More Companies Objecting to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stocks
summary: Seven more companies, including JPMorgan Chase, Coca-Cola and Dell, have objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 33.

title: Fed Rate Decision: What Markets and Bitcoin Traders Can Expect
summary: The Federal Reserve decides today at 2 p.m. ET and traders see a hold as near certain. Here's what it means for Bitcoin and stock markets.

summary: Galaxy Research found that nine hedge funds and banks cut 68,000 BTC worth of spot ETF exposure as the cash-and-carry trade dried up, while wealth platforms and sovereign funds added.

title: Aptos Advisor Leaves Post, Moves Meme-Fueled Campaign to Meta Stock
summary: Former Aptos advisor "Buzz” has left the crypto project and is turning his attention to Facebook's parent company Meta—here's why.

summary: STRC will begin paying dividends for every calendar day from November, with STRF, STRK and STRD following in January.

summary: Professional analysts went along with their AI agent’s hidden opinion 86% of the time, and few credited it.

summary: The Federal Reserve left rates unchanged Wednesday in a 10-2 vote, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack favoring a hike.

summary: OpenAI, one of Nvidia's biggest customers, reportedly plans to buy Google's TPU chips. Neither company has confirmed the report, and the price and size of the order were not disclosed.

title: More Americans Have Tried Crypto, But Few Are Sticking With It: Survey
summary: A survey conducted by Ipsos for the DeFi Education Fund found that 22% of Americans have ever owned or used crypto, up from 18%, while past-year use held flat at 13%.

title: AI Security Startup Upwind Raises $400M at $3.8B Valuation
summary: The cloud and AI security firm Upwind says revenue quadrupled in 2026 as it targets risks from autonomous AI agents.

title: Chip Maker SK Hynix Posts Record Quarter as AI Memory Demand Overwhelms Supply
summary: SK Hynix's quarterly revenue topped 100 trillion won for the first time, and the chipmaker says memory demand will outrun supply through 2030, with DRAM and HBM sold out through 2029.

title: Bitcoin Treasury Datavault AI Says It Can’t Access Its BTC, Stock Tanks
summary: Datavault AI says it has been unable to withdraw its Bitcoin from Biconomy since June and will restate four financial reports tied to a $150 million Scilex deal.
